coverage.finding: The folio label '161' with a superscript 'b' is at the top left, about native (400,330)-(520,430). It is correctly recorded as a page-number record.

The parenthetical ink note is at about native (1665-2385, 3845-3920). The literal text is a probable reading. The letter forms resemble 'Seve', 'indea' and 'alos', and the macron and accent diacritics on 'Āśīrvāda' are not securely legible. The candidate's uncertainty notes are kept. Faint vertical smudges above 'index also' are offset marks, not text.

The extent note 'ff. 1-7 in 54 verses' is followed by an arrow. The arrow's head is at its LEFT end, about x 3050, next to the note. Its shaft runs right to the gutter at about x 3205. A separate dash sits beyond the gutter at about x 3285-3365, y 3855. The candidate wrongly says the arrow points toward the gutter, and that fol. 162 has its own 'matching arrow'. On fol. 162 the '← —' at the left edge is this same mark from fol. 161b, captured in the adjacent image. It is not an independent mark on fol. 162.
